source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of queue properties (PDF 101).

blocks.text: Queue ki aham properties (khasusiyat) yeh hain:

items: Tarteeb qaim rehti hai (order preservation): queue items ki tarteeb yaad rakhti hai. Jo item pehle dala, woh pehle bahar aata hai.
FIFO usool: queue “First-In, First-Out” qaide par chalti hai, yaani pehle dala gaya item pehle nikalta hai.
Dynamic size: items jorne ya nikalne se queue bari ya chhoti hoti rehti hai; us ka size items ki tadaad ke mutabiq khud badal jata hai.

blocks.prompt: Queue stack se kaise mukhtalif hai?
blocks.explanation: Queue aage se sab se purana item nikalti hai (FIFO); stack top se sab se naya item nikalta hai (LIFO).

items: Queue ki khasusiyat: tarteeb qaim, FIFO, dynamic size.
